title: Last day of one entity
description: Every value one entity recorded in the last 24 hours, oldest first. Replace <entity_id> with the entity, for example sensor.outdoor_temperature.
sql:
SELECT time, state, value
FROM chronicle.history
WHERE entity_id = '<entity_id>'
  AND time > now() - INTERVAL '1 day'
ORDER BY time

title: Daily averages for a year
description: Mean, minimum and maximum per day over the last year, from the daily averages: fast however long the history is. Replace <entity_id> with a numeric entity.
sql:
SELECT d.bucket AS day, round(d.mean::numeric, 2) AS mean, d.min, d.max
FROM chronicle.states_daily d
JOIN chronicle.entities e ON e.id = d.entity
WHERE e.entity_id = '<entity_id>'
  AND d.bucket > now() - INTERVAL '1 year'
ORDER BY d.bucket

title: One month, day by day
description: The minimum, maximum and mean of each day of the last month, with the number of values behind them. Replace <entity_id> with a numeric entity.
sql:
SELECT d.bucket AS day, d.min, d.max, round(d.mean::numeric, 2) AS mean, d.samples
FROM chronicle.states_daily d
JOIN chronicle.entities e ON e.id = d.entity
WHERE e.entity_id = '<entity_id>'
  AND d.bucket > now() - INTERVAL '1 month'
ORDER BY d.bucket

title: Busiest entities (24 h)
description: The 20 entities that wrote the most rows in the last 24 hours. Busy entities you don't need are the first to exclude in the integration's options.
sql:
SELECT e.entity_id, e.name, count(*) AS rows
FROM chronicle.states s
JOIN chronicle.entities e ON e.id = s.entity
WHERE s.time > now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY e.entity_id, e.name
ORDER BY rows DESC
LIMIT 20

title: Changes per entity today
description: How many changes each entity recorded since midnight, in Home Assistant's time zone. Shows what is busy right now.
sql:
SELECT e.entity_id, count(*) AS changes, max(s.time) AS last_change
FROM chronicle.states s
JOIN chronicle.entities e ON e.id = s.entity
WHERE s.time >= date_trunc('day', now(), coalesce((SELECT value FROM chronicle.meta WHERE key = 'aggregate_time_zone'), 'UTC'))
GROUP BY e.entity_id
ORDER BY changes DESC

title: Last value of every sensor
description: The newest state of every sensor with its unit and when it was recorded. One index lookup per sensor, so it stays fast on a large history.
sql:
SELECT e.entity_id, coalesce(l.state, l.value::text) AS state, e.unit, l.time
FROM chronicle.entities e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT s.time, s.state, s.value FROM chronicle.states s
    WHERE s.entity = e.id ORDER BY s.time DESC LIMIT 1
) l
WHERE e.domain = 'sensor'
ORDER BY e.entity_id

title: Entities that went silent
description: Entities whose last recorded change is more than 24 hours ago, the quietest first. Useful to spot a device that stopped reporting.
sql:
SELECT e.entity_id, coalesce(l.state, l.value::text) AS last_state, l.time AS last_change,
       now() - l.time AS silent_for
FROM chronicle.entities e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT s.time, s.state, s.value FROM chronicle.states s
    WHERE s.entity = e.id ORDER BY s.time DESC LIMIT 1
) l
WHERE l.time < now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
ORDER BY l.time

title: Hours on per day
description: How long a switch, light or binary sensor was on per day over the last 30 days, worked out from its on/off changes. Replace <entity_id>; a stretch past midnight counts for the day it started.
sql:
WITH changes AS (
    SELECT s.time, s.value,
           lead(s.time, 1, now()) OVER (ORDER BY s.time) AS until
    FROM chronicle.states s
    JOIN chronicle.entities e ON e.id = s.entity
    WHERE e.entity_id = '<entity_id>'
      AND s.time > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS day,
       round((coalesce(sum(extract(epoch FROM until - time)) FILTER (WHERE value = 1), 0) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS hours_on
FROM changes
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

title: Attribute over time
description: The value of one attribute at every recorded change, the newest first, such as a thermostat's target temperature. Replace <entity_id> and <attribute>.
sql:
SELECT time, state, attributes->>'<attribute>' AS attribute
FROM chronicle.history
WHERE entity_id = '<entity_id>'
  AND attributes ? '<attribute>'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 500

title: Top attribute keys
description: The attribute names found most often, counted over the distinct attribute sets. Shows what the attributes take space for.
sql:
SELECT key, count(*) AS attribute_sets
FROM chronicle.attributes, jsonb_object_keys(data) AS key
GROUP BY key
ORDER BY attribute_sets DESC
LIMIT 30

title: Compression of the chunks
description: Every chunk of the history with its time range, whether it is compressed and its size before and after. The newest chunks are compressed once they are older than the integration's Compress after setting.
sql:
SELECT c.chunk_name, c.range_start, c.range_end, c.is_compressed,
       pg_size_pretty(s.before_compression_total_bytes) AS before,
       pg_size_pretty(s.after_compression_total_bytes) AS after
FROM timescaledb_information.chunks c
LEFT JOIN chunk_compression_stats('chronicle.states') s USING (chunk_schema, chunk_name)
WHERE c.hypertable_schema = 'chronicle' AND c.hypertable_name = 'states'
ORDER BY c.range_start DESC

title: Table sizes
description: The size and number of chunks of every hypertable in the database: the history and the hourly and daily averages.
sql:
SELECT format('%I.%I', hypertable_schema, hypertable_name) AS hypertable,
       pg_size_pretty(hypertable_size(format('%I.%I', hypertable_schema, hypertable_name)::regclass)) AS size,
       num_chunks,
       compression_enabled
FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables
ORDER BY hypertable_size(format('%I.%I', hypertable_schema, hypertable_name)::regclass) DESC
